Rae (PM): Quick sync — we need to pick which features are launch-critical vs nice-to-have for the April release. I'm worried fidelity is eating coverage.
Diego (Eng): totally. current build can't meet our p95 < 200ms target if we keep 3 heavy transforms live.
Mina (Design): From UX testing: two small flows drive 80% of activation. The rest is low-frequency delight.
Anya (Data): +1. Metric-wise, weekly active on the two flows = 82%. secondary flows < 5% active.
Rae (PM): Proposal: keep full fidelity for primary flows, degrade or postpone fidelity for secondaries. That means delay 'rich-summary' and 'autotag' for v1.
Diego (Eng): Implementation note: we can feature-flag 'rich-summary' and route requests to a cheaper model variant. That buys latency headroom.
Anya (Data): Can we measure quality delta with a small A/B? If degradation > 8% NPS impact, we reevaluate.
Mina (Design): We need an acceptance checklist for the primary flows so we don't regress. I'll drop a short list in #design-qa.
Rae (PM): Decision options: (A) Ship April with reduced coverage but higher fidelity on primaries. (B) Push launch 3 weeks to preserve all features. Need to pick by EOD.
Diego (Eng): Ops constraints: option B requires extra infra ramp (2x burst capacity) and risks cost overrun.
Rae (PM): Can we write a simple gating rule? Something like: "if e2e conversion on primaries >= baseline and p95 < 200ms, proceed". Otherwise pause rollout.
Anya (Data): Draft gating rule OK. Add cost guardrail: incremental infra spend < 15% of budget.
Diego (Eng): I'll stub the rollout config with canary windows and a fallback to the smaller model.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary at 2026-04-01T09:00Z, rollback window 2h.
Mina (Design): Re: rollout messaging — we should document degraded features in release notes. I'll prepare copy.
Rae (PM): Action list: Diego - prod config + model-variant fallback (due EOD). Anya - A/B metric plan + gating thresholds (due noon). Mina - acceptance checklist + release notes copy (due EOD). If anyone has objections, speak now.
Diego (Eng): On it.
Anya (Data): On it — will ping with thresholds.
Mina (Design): Done.
Rae (PM): OK closing. We'll default to option A unless the gating metrics fail in canary. :thumbsup:
